name: Node.js
subtitle: JavaScript runtime
creator: Ryan Dahl
description: A runtime that runs JavaScript outside the browser on Google's V8 engine. Its event-driven, non-blocking I/O handles many connections at once efficiently. Frameworks such as Express and NestJS sit on top of it to add routing and structure.

languages.youWrite: JavaScript or TypeScript (Node can now strip types natively)

concepts.explanation: One thread juggles many I/O tasks without blocking.
The package registry and your project manifest.
Readable asynchronous code built on Promises.
Process data in chunks instead of all at once.
Offload CPU-heavy work from the main thread.

codeSamples.label: JavaScript · server.mjs

pros: One language for front end and back end
npm is the largest package ecosystem
Most used web technology in the Stack Overflow 2025 survey (48.7%)
cons: Single-threaded, so CPU-heavy work needs workers or other services
Tooling churn such as ESM versus CommonJS

surveys.source: Stack Overflow Developer Survey 2025, all respondents
